development.finish_summary: Delivered parametric twin multi-bay side-truss bracket source, parameters, engineering report, and both STEP/FCStd instance snapshots. Both final source reconstructions passed all public geometry/interface, space/access, mass/backbone and STEP equivalence checks. Masses: B1-01 141.772 g; B1-02 164.206 g. B1-01 final dual-mesh six-case diagnostic passed all five groups with valid convergence. B1-02 final strengthened design was submitted to job_009; that analysis was still running at the last report-writing poll, so the report honestly leaves its final FEA/FullPass unconfirmed. Independent acceptance remains authoritative.
